resolved_by_v4_design: NOT_RUN can no longer become PASS
all hard ACs require explicit PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED status
technical accuracy uses declared key terms
local smoke scoring is separated from official OpenASR hard-AC scoring
model revision and model artifact tree hash are frozen before inference
streaming latency requires wall-clock pacing and >=100 measured warm runs
dictionary/context paired evidence has dedicated metrics
semantic integrity evidence is explicit and cannot default to zero
all unresolved dependencies are reported together before execution
external_product_pass_dependencies: official pinned OpenASR English short-form result for the frozen Qwen revision
paired Japanese Aqua results on the same frozen fixture IDs with Aqua version/date
current_conclusion: The workflow is now structured for one-pass execution without ad-hoc repair. Missing external evidence produces machine-readable BLOCKED, while independent Qwen evidence continues automatically.
closure_rule: Product PASS only when every v4 hard AC is explicitly PASS; any FAIL, BLOCKED, missing, or NOT_RUN prohibits closure.
